title: Re-study firstmate work handling and rebuild the explainer page
summary: Re-study firstmate's work handling against the pinned source, so the study includes the missed behaviors (teardown reopening a backlog item, yolo self-merge of green work, and places freed only by a recorded PR or cleanup, with relaunches and secondmates never counted) and any other gaps. Then rebuild the explainer page from the corrected study.

defaults_applied.how: Every claim cites a path and quote from the pinned source.
The kept study test and the site build are run.
Criteria check the three corrected behaviors appear in the claims and on the page.
The whole study is re-read against the source, not only the three examples.
Plain wording for an outside reader.

assumptions: Goal: a complete and correct study of firstmate's work handling at the pinned commit, so the explainer page's readers (an outside reader checking it against the source) can rate it highly.
The page is generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- site` from studies/firstmate-work-handling and is not committed, so it is rebuilt by running the renderer. No renderer change is expected.
The pin stays at the existing sha 6407052f4c521e39401ce2305dfa45d201249827.
The reviewer's three misses are examples. The producer should re-read the source for other gaps in work handling, such as the slot and capacity rules.

acceptance_criteria.text: claims.json contains cited claims, each with a path and quote from the pinned source, stating that teardown can reopen a backlog item rather than close it, and under which condition.
claims.json states that with yolo on, firstmate merges green work itself, and what happens with yolo off.
claims.json states that only a recorded PR or cleanup frees a place, and that relaunches and secondmates are never counted.
model.json, rationales.json, findings.json and intro.json are updated to match the new claims. Every claim id they reference exists, and nothing contradicts the three corrections.
A reader can open the rebuilt page and find the three corrected behaviors, each citing the pinned commit 6407052f; the pin in pin.json is unchanged.

Run `cargo test` from the repository root. The study rules test in crates/athena-cap-study/src/rules.rs passes, which means every quote is found at its cited path in the pinned source. The xtask site tests also pass.
Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site`. It succeeds with no unknown claim id error and renders index.html. Run `cargo clippy` and `cargo fmt --check`, and both are clean.
No secrets or personal data are written, and the study is re-derived from the pinned source, not just patched with the three points the reviewer gave.

out_of_scope: Changing the pinned commit or studying other systems.
Redesigning the site layout or renderer beyond what the new content needs.
departures: A study with a re-read of the source and a site rebuild costs more and takes longer than the reference. Quotes must match the pinned source exactly.
